# Asset credits

All files are free-licensed, except the generated models below, which the project owner made and owns. Downloaded files were handled as untrusted data (binary only). Total size about 69 MB (audio about 23 MB). The sound effects and music are the exception: licensed through the owner's Epidemic Sound subscription, see below.

## Generated by the project owner (AssetHub, Tripo 3.1), owned by the project owner
Generated with AssetHub (Tripo 3.1 mesh, Tripo v2.5 auto-rig for the people), paid for and owned by the project owner. Shrunk with gltf-transform (textures resized and re-encoded to WebP; the palm welded and simplified to about 7.5k triangles).
- models/character/male.glb - the player: a man in a teal floral shirt and jeans. Rigged (52 bones, A-pose, no clips); the game retargets the mannequin's clips onto it. 1024 px textures.
- models/character/female.glb - a woman in a white tank top and denim shorts, for pedestrians. Rigged without neck or head bones. 1024 px textures.
- models/vehicle/sports_car.glb - an orange wedge sports car body without wheels (the game adds its own). 2048 px textures.
- models/vehicle/police.glb - a black and white police sedan body without wheels, with a roof light bar. 2048 px textures.
- models/vehicle/boat.glb - a sport speedboat (white hull, teal and orange stripe, cream seats, outboard motor), about 23k vertices. 2048 px WebP textures, 1.5 MB (from 3.7 MB). Generated for Phase 10d.
- models/vegetation/palm.glb - a coconut palm with solid fronds. 1024 px textures.
- models/vegetation/palm_far.glb - the same palm simplified to about 2.3k triangles with 512 px textures, drawn beyond about 110 m.

## Generated by the project owner (Higgsfield), owned by the project owner
Generated 2026-10-15 by the project owner with Higgsfield (gpt_image_2_5; the two menu images upscaled with bytedance_image_upscale 2K), converted to webp. Original fictional scenes, no logos or brands.
- ui/menu.webp (2560x1434) - sunset boulevard, the player leaning on an orange supercar on the right third: the main menu backdrop.
- ui/menu_night.webp (2560x1434) - dusk skyline from the ocean with neon hotels: the pause menu backdrop (blurred) and a loading slide.
- ui/load_car.webp, ui/load_police.webp, ui/load_beach.webp, ui/load_swim.webp (1344x752) - loading screen slideshow.
- ui/logo.webp (1113x590, transparent) - the "GTA 6 BEFORE GTA 6" title logo: neon synthwave chrome lettering with a sunset and a palm. Generated 2026-10-16 (gpt_image_2_5, option 1 of 4 chosen by the owner), background removed with Higgsfield image_background_remover. Original design, not derived from any official logo.
- ../apple-touch-icon.png (180x180) - the same logo fitted into a square. ../favicon.svg is hand-drawn (a "6" on the logo's sunset), no generated art.

### Trees, bushes, rocks, grass (Poly Haven, CC0, Phase 10b)
The scanned trees are millions of triangles each. Each was cut down with gltf-transform and meshoptimizer: the trunk simplified twice (`bark`, and a few hundred triangles as `lite`), and the leaves or twigs baked into a "billboard cloud" (`foliage`): the foliage is cut into 1 to 2.6 m voxels, and each voxel's leaves are rendered onto two or three cards in one 2048 px atlas (WebP). Each file is about 1 MB and 2k to 5k triangles. Bark textures are 512 px WebP.
- models/vegetation/fir_a.glb, fir_b.glb - "Fir Tree 01" (variants a and b), https://polyhaven.com/a/fir_tree_01 - Rob Tuytel, Rico Cilliers - CC0
- models/vegetation/jacaranda.glb - "Jacaranda Tree", https://polyhaven.com/a/jacaranda_tree - Rob Tuytel, Rico Cilliers - CC0
- models/vegetation/island_tree_01.glb - "Island Tree 01", https://polyhaven.com/a/island_tree_01 - Rob Tuytel, Rico Cilliers - CC0
- models/vegetation/island_tree_02.glb - "Island Tree 02", https://polyhaven.com/a/island_tree_02 - Rob Tuytel, Rico Cilliers - CC0
- models/vegetation/tree_small_02.glb - "Tree Small 02", https://polyhaven.com/a/tree_small_02 - Rico Cilliers - CC0
- models/vegetation/bush_a.glb .. bush_d.glb - "Searsia Lucida" (variants a to d), https://polyhaven.com/a/searsia_lucida - James Ray Cock, Jenelle van Heerden - CC0. Baked the same way at a 1024 px atlas.
- models/vegetation/rocks_moss_01.glb, rocks_moss_02.glb - "Rock Moss Set 01" and "02", https://polyhaven.com/a/rock_moss_set_01, https://polyhaven.com/a/rock_moss_set_02 - Kless Gyzen - CC0. Simplified to about 6% (300 to 450 triangles a rock), 512 px WebP.
- textures/grass_clumps.webp (1024x512) - four grass clumps cut from the color and alpha maps of "Grass Medium 01", https://polyhaven.com/a/grass_medium_01 - Rob Tuytel, Rico Cilliers - CC0
- Authors as listed on each Poly Haven page at download (2026-10-16); all Poly Haven assets are CC0.

## Sound effects and music (Epidemic Sound, owner subscription)
Licensed through the project owner's Epidemic Sound subscription (the owner accepted its terms); not free-licensed, not for reuse outside this game. Processed with `scripts/audio.mjs` (ffmpeg: silence trimmed, loudness-normalised, mono 96 kbps effects, 128 kbps stereo ambience and music, seamless crossfaded loops, footsteps sliced into single steps). Files are in `audio/`, about 23 MB in all; only about 60 KB loads before Play.
